name: QR Code
description: A corner widget that opens the chosen QR code full screen on tap, handy for sharing this kiosk's Wi-Fi credentials with a phone.
author: shin-01

settings.title: Show corner widget
settings.description: Keep the tappable widget in a display corner.

settings.title: Widget title
settings.description: The label on the corner widget and the heading of the QR card.

settings.title: QR content
settings.description: What the QR encodes: a WIFI: string, a URL or any text. Example: WIFI:T:WPA;S:MyNetwork;P:MyPassword;;

settings.title: Widget icon
settings.description: The icon on the corner widget.

settings.title: QR size
settings.description: The size of the QR code in the full screen card.
